## What This Book Covers {#core-book-map .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="section-card-grid">
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Begin Gently</span>
    <h3>Start Here and Methods</h3>
    <p>Learn how to read equations, reason with units, think about maps as data, and use the project’s shared tool bench.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Build Confidence</span>
    <h3>Maths for Modelling Space</h3>
    <p>Variables, rates, growth, terrain, and spatial interaction establish the modelling language of the book.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Move Outward</span>
    <h3>Earth Systems, GIS, and Hazards</h3>
    <p>Environmental process models, spatial analysis tools, and motivating risk problems build the strongest central spine.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Finish Broadly</span>
    <h3>Gateway Human Geography</h3>
    <p>Trade, cities, and pricing appear here as spatial systems without overwhelming the environmental-modelling core.</p>
  </article>
</div>
```
